source: MIT Senseable City Lab Rio — Vidigal DTM + building footprints
encoding: interleaved int8 x, int8 y, uint8 z, uint8 category (0=terrain, 1=building); 4 bytes/point
terrain_display: terrain re-sampled on a regular grid (7868 points) by linear interpolation of the 2500 sampled DTM cells this file previously carried; rooftop outline points thinned to 45% (4601 of 10029); no new source data
